title: Hurricane Florence - ANG Aerial Refueling
description: An HH-60G Pave Hawk Helicopter from the 129th Rescue Squadron, Caifornia Air National Guard, receives fuel from an HC-130J Combat King II from the 211th Rescue Squadron, Alaska Air National Guard in support of Hurricane Florence relief operations over North Carolina on Sept. 17, 2018. The Air National Guardsmen are delivering support to civil authorities in response to relief efforts. (U.S. Air Force video by Master Sgt. Dominique Dickens)
